# ERCOT NP3-965 SCED Gen Resource corpus — RESTORE ROW-COUNT MANIFEST
#
# Scope: the UNTRACKED window only — publication months 2024-04 .. 2026-03
# (700 parts; deliveries 2024-02-01 .. 2025-12-31). The tracked ERCOT-157
# window (pubs 2023-03 .. 2024-03) is NOT listed: it is live at tip and its
# bytes are hashed in SHA256SUMS.txt.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. SHA256SUMS.txt hashes the ORIGINAL post-slim bytes and
# remains their identity record, but it CANNOT accept a re-fetch restore:
# parquet bytes are writer-version specific (the tracked shards were written by
# parquet-cpp-arrow 24.0.0; a 25.0.1 writer reproduces the CONTENT but not the
# bytes — measured ercot-248, 2026-08-31, on 2024-04.part0000: manifest
# 11c02e4e…, re-fetch+slim 93f9d398…, while tracked 2024-03.part0016 rehashes
# to its manifest line exactly). Row count, column count and delivery day are
# writer-independent, so THIS is the instrument a restore is judged against:
# a restore that reproduces every line below is accepted.
#
# Restore command (verified end-to-end 2026-08-31, ercot-248):
#   python scripts/data/fetch_ercot_sced_corpus_shards.py \
#       --pub-start 2024-04-01 --pub-end 2026-03-01 \
#       --max-delivery-date 2025-12-31 --manifest <scratch>/manifest.json
#   # then move the 27 HASL-less RTC+B parts into rtcb-format-2026/
#   # (2026-02.part0002-0027 + 2026-03.part0000) — DETECT BY MISSING HASL,
#   # never by assumed numbering.
#
# --pub-start is 2024-04-01, NOT the 2024-03-24 MIS retention floor: pubs
# 2024-03-24..31 are already on disk as the tracked 2024-03.part0009-0016, and
# re-fetching them appends duplicate parts that silently double-weight 8
# delivery days in every consumer that streams the corpus.
#
# Bytes are deliberately NOT recorded (compression is writer-specific). The
# 2026-08-31 restore measured 2,341.5 MiB for this window, raw/un-slimmed
# (188 cols pre-RTC+B, 193/195 cols RTC+B).
#
# Verify a restored corpus against this file:
#   python scripts/data/audit_sced_corpus.py --check
# Regenerate the rows after a legitimate source change (this header is kept):
#   python scripts/data/audit_sced_corpus.py --write-manifest
# The delivery day is read from each part's own SCED Time Stamp values, never
# from a filename — the filename carries the PUBLICATION month, which leads
# the delivery by ~60 days.
#
# parts: 700   total rows: 88,561,421
# columns: part<TAB>delivery_day(s)<TAB>rows<TAB>cols
